definition: One access = reading the VALUE of any recording in the calibration partition. Hashing the recording-id set does not count (that is split structure and reveals no distributional information); reading values to compute raw_data_hash or s_f does count.
first_access_expected_at: calibration stage 1 start, after stage 0 is complete and frozen
note: Append-only. The runner must append one entry per access with timestamp, purpose, code_version and the resulting raw_data_hash. A count > 0 with no frozen stage 0 artifact means the preregistered ordering was violated and the run must stop.
